name: Brahma Temple, Pushkar
summary: Jagatpita Brahma Mandir at Pushkar — the most famous of the few temples dedicated to Lord Brahma.
famousFor: Rare Brahma shrine · often called the only major Brahma temple
mythology: Puranic memory says Brahma’s lotus petal created Pushkar Lake, and he performed a yajna on its banks. When Savitri arrived late and found Gayatri seated for the rite, she cursed that Brahma would rarely be worshipped — yet Pushkar remained the living seat of his darshan. Four-faced Brahma and Gayatri receive pilgrims after a lake bath, especially on Kartik Purnima during the Pushkar fair.
